# anecdotes_roles (Data Source)

Lists every role visible to the tenant — built-in global roles plus tenant-specific custom roles. Useful for discovering valid `extends`/`permissions` values for `anecdotes_role` without hardcoding them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover every built-in global role and its key, to reference in a custom
# role's `extends` without hardcoding role keys.
data "anecdotes_roles" "built_in" {
  is_custom = false
}

output "built_in_role_keys" {
  value = [for r in data.anecdotes_roles.built_in.roles : r.role_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_custom` (Boolean) Filter by tenant-scoped custom roles only (true) or built-in global roles only (false).
- `name_contains` (String) Filter roles whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of roles matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of roles matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the role.
- `extends` (List of String) Base role keys this role inherits permissions from.
- `full_access_frameworks` (List of String) Framework IDs this role has full access to, or null when unscoped.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Whether this is a tenant-scoped custom role (as opposed to a built-in global role).
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) The role's live, resolved permission set.
- `role_id` (String) The role's key.
